title: Undo for a deleted set in a live workout is hidden from screen readers and vanishes after 4 seconds
what: When a member removes a set during a workout, a small 'Set removed  Undo' bar shows for 4 seconds and then goes away for good. The Undo word is not marked as a button and has no spoken name, the bar is not read out when it appears, and its tap area is small. A screen reader user, or anyone slow to react, loses the only way to get the set back. The app's own undo bar used elsewhere does all of this right (read out, 48 point button).
expected: The removed-set bar is read out, Undo is a named button of full finger size, and it stays long enough to reach (or uses the app's shared undo bar).
how_often: every time a set is removed
fix_line: Show the removed-set message with the app's shared undo bar instead of the hand-made one

title: A few buttons on these screens are smaller than a finger
what: The previous and next month (or year) buttons on the monthly report are only about 28 points tall. The Cancel word while picking two photos to compare has no minimum size. The minus and plus buttons for sets and reps in the routine editor reach about 46 points. The app's own rule elsewhere is 48.
expected: Every one of these is at least 48 points to the finger, like the other buttons on the same screens.
fix_line: Give these buttons a 48 point minimum height and width

title: In the routine editor, a screen reader is not told when Move up, Move down, minus or plus cannot be used, or what the number is
what: At the top or bottom of the list, or at the lowest or highest sets and reps, these buttons only turn grey. A screen reader still announces them as normal buttons, and tapping does nothing. The minus and plus buttons say 'Decrease sets' or 'Increase sets' but not the current number, so the member cannot hear the result of a tap.
expected: Buttons that cannot be used are announced as unavailable, and the current number is spoken with the minus and plus buttons.
fix_line: Mark these buttons unavailable when greyed and add the current number to what they say
